shots.description: The hero cover: one photograph (the Neon portrait) in every window of the hero-trio layout, graded Sunset Print, title VICE COAST laid over the photo itself.
The editor with a photo loaded: Add-your-photo first, per-window crop and zoom controls, Neon Tide look over the same Neon photo in every window.
Portrait export: the Boulevard photo in all four windows of the quad layout, Gold Hour grade, GOLD HOUR over the photo.
Square export: the Street photo in every window of the banner layout, Sunset Print grade, SUNSET RUN over the photo.
